name: China Hainan Rubber Industry Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: China Hainan Rubber Industry Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the production and sale of rubber products in China. It is involved in the production of natural rubber seedlings, specialty rubbers, and professional rubbers; customize and supply planed timber, decorative timber, finger-jointed boards, modified timber, and other wood product base materials; land development and leasing; logging, transportation, and processing of rubber trees and artificial trees; and operation of sale and trading platform for natural rubber. The company also offers whole latex, concentrated latex, TSR 10, TSR 20, SCR 10, SCR 20, 10# radial rubber, clear rubber, mixed rubber, smoked sheet rubber, and Indonesian standard…
